subject.title: #282 A: add trusted gateway context contract

question: Should post-LLM plugins receive the complete raw inbound message context as ambient SDK data, or should OpenClaw extend its existing scoped trusted fields and provide action-specific provenance only to the owning plugin?
rationale: This is a permanent public plugin privacy and trust-boundary choice; code review can identify overexposure and provenance defects, but cannot choose the intended ambient data-access policy.

options.title: Extend scoped contexts
options.body: Add only the required immutable message and correlation fields to existing tool/hook contexts, with an explicit aggregate representation for collect mode.

options.title: Approve full ambient context
options.body: Keep the complete object but explicitly document plugin trust, privacy exposure, collect semantics, compatibility guarantees, and the intended consumers before merge.

options.title: Pause until adapter design
options.body: Defer the public contract until the attendance adapter demonstrates which fields and hook boundary are actually required.

recommendation.title: Extend scoped contexts
recommendation.body: Add only the required immutable message and correlation fields to existing tool/hook contexts, with an explicit aggregate representation for collect mode.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent work on the agent runtime and current plugin context APIs makes this the best available owner for the permanent boundary decision.
